decisions.decision: T-251 is done, so build on a branch cut from origin/main. First run `git merge-base --is-ancestor e4bd0b8 origin/main`. If that fails, branch from tantra-walkthroughs and rebase later. Add jobs in cloud/src, each with an auto/you block. (3) G104/X016: after one OAuth grant, create the project, enable the APIs and make one service account and key per Workspace user via Resource Manager, Service Usage, IAM and Org Policy, then upload to Tantra. Only the DWD Authorize click stays with the attendee. (4) G105: read Tantra campaign status and stamp the sheet for steps 6 and 11. (5) G110: weekly GA4 Data API read with the 3%/1% gate. (6) G011: GA4 Admin API job for property, web stream and key event. Run every write path against the vendor simulator only. Run the probes, merge to main, and mark the ids fixed in AUDIT.md with the commit.
